assumptions.statement: Repository provisional SITE_BOUNDARY and KEY_AREA polygons are normalized containers for concept generation, not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: Machine values remain reproducible but public display is rounded; all geometry, ratios and drawings must be regenerated when official polygons arrive.

assumptions.statement: No surveyed building inventory, ownership, structure, height, heritage or approved retain-renovate-demolish classification is available.
assumptions.impact: BUILDING_FOOTPRINT features are reversible program envelopes only; floor area, FAR, height and demolition decisions stay unknown.

assumptions.statement: Road redlines, traffic counts, rail interface conditions, parking demand and engineering alignments are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: ROAD_CENTERLINE features show access intent only and cannot support bridge, tunnel, junction or parking feasibility claims.

assumptions.statement: Named implementing organizations, land rights, approvals, procurement routes, insurance and committed budgets have not been confirmed.
assumptions.impact: Action packages use accountable role types and low-confidence participant planning envelopes; no government, enterprise or institution is represented as committed.
assumptions.trigger: written mandate, qualified quotes, insurance and financing decision

assumptions.statement: Protocol tests use explicit deterministic synthetic inputs and paired counterfactuals with no personal data and do not measure field service performance.
assumptions.impact: The offline runner proves reproducible policy logic only; a field pilot needs consent, baseline, accessibility, insurance, safeguarding and independent public evaluation.
assumptions.trigger: approved limited pilot and independently reviewed field evidence

assumptions.statement: Ecology, soil, tree, hydrology, flood-control and maintenance baselines are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Blue-green pockets and ratios are design allocations, not ecological performance or sponge-city compliance claims.

assumptions.statement: Heritage inventories, protection zones, view corridors and structural conditions have not been supplied.
assumptions.impact: Landmarks are removable public components; installation requires heritage, structure, fire, accessibility and copyright review.

assumptions.statement: Municipal utilities, electrical capacity, compute-energy demand, drainage, fire and emergency-response baselines are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Edge-compute and public-service prototypes begin with low-power mock interfaces; capacity and permanent installation remain unknown.
